artboards.title: Request rules — 5th tab: How requests come in
The hub lane after — intake's new row + the identity fold

annotations.text: Kevin's calls 2026-08-29: intake = the 5TH TAB on /setup/request-rules ('How requests come in'), with its OWN hub row like eligibility got (compliance lane 10 → 11, item 7; every tab's item-count string follows) · the IDENTITY FOLD rides in the same pass: the agency screen's Attest also signs the identity section, and the 'Which state's law' row doors to /setup/agency — two fewer reasons to visit jurisdiction-config, per the goal of retiring that screen entirely.

The designated-addresses rule (TX-0006) renders as a FIXED law card that reads the agency screen's mailing + contact e-mail — no second place to type an address. Changing them is an agency-screen act; this tab only shows what they legally mean (requests arriving elsewhere need not be answered, hand delivery and approved methods excepted).

The three choices: CHANNELS (Master.g1) — the law's floor renders as fixed-checked (mail, e-mail, hand delivery; no phone channel exists to switch on, § 552.234(a) requires writing); the city elects portal/fax. ACKNOWLEDGMENT (Master.g4) — send timing, suggested same business day; standard wording until the letter-template slice. ESTIMATE CAPTURE (Master.p3) — lives in the FEE store today; the tab becomes its single home, confirms write through (the F2 waiver-decider pattern).

Stowaway retired: the import also filed a copy of the vagueness-wording knob (Master.bv) in the intake domain — no citations, no default, read by nothing. Its single, confirmable home is the Clarification tab; the intake copy is removed at import + migration (same twice-homing cleanup F2 did for the estimate/deposit pair).

Build implications: new hub row `intake` (compliance, door ?tab=intake, foldSections:['intake'] — the intake profile section attests from the tab) · TAB_CONCEPTS.intake = ['intake','custody'] (exactly TX-0005 + TX-0006) · intake confirms ride the template-knob confirm path (goLive.confirm on the intake domain) · verify_setup_hub counts 35 → 36, lanes [11,8,5,4,7] · verify_request_rules + verify_agency_setup grow sections · laneIndex strings 'of 10' → 'of 11'.
